calibration_runner_prefix_parity.note: Comparison during continuous calibration inference after the full development prefix was cached; no calibration selection performed.

limitations: Green shows the named cow's publisher box; red shows the propagated box. Raw predicted masks were not cached. Large boxes cannot distinguish mask leakage, disconnected fragments, and physical identity drift by themselves.

mask_inspection_provenance.scope: Cached development prefix of the subsequent continuous calibration run. All630 original development boxes are exactly equal, but original full masks were not retained, so mask-bitwise equality cannot be proven. No calibration-condition selection or adjusted development metric was performed.

tracking.note: Global one-to-one track/cow assignment at IoU .5 on 1 fps scoring timestamps; not permanent cow recognition.

scope: Independent frozen Cutie metric replay and every named-error geometry; no adjusted metrics or model tuning
